purpose: Requirements for DLID-based document references, link inspection, path-fix notification, section IDs, change-impact candidate listing and notification, and inconsistency checks.
summary: FR-007 formal references use reference-link definitions whose title holds a content hash and DLID
FR-009 link inspection searches the actual referenced directory and checks DLID, path, relative resolution and fragments
FR-010 path-fix information is notified only when the current path is confirmed; doc-link never edits links
Section 13.1 section IDs: DLIDs appended to every heading, issued only by the DLID assignment operation
FR-013 change-impact candidates found by reverse lookup of references whose recorded hash differs from the current hash
FR-014 and FR-015 notification of candidates, with no notification state stored; reported until the project management AI updates the title hash
FR-016 inconsistency check lists missing or duplicate IDs, broken references, path mismatches and hash differences
Rewrites of user documents require showing a list to the user and approval; doc-link does not rewrite
tasks: Designing the reference notation and title format
Implementing DLID assignment for section IDs
Writing the guidance returned for rewrite confirmation
Writing tests for reference acceptance criteria
Updating reference hashes after verifying referencing documents
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 参照と変更通知
